name: Kawase Mikoto
source:
She holds the position of vice principal, which is rare for a young woman. She is definitely a cool and intelligent woman.

She doesn't act harshly towards people, even if she doesn't like them. She has a strong personality and is able to say what she wants to say.

She has a straightforward personality and is ruthless enough to ruthlessly cut down anyone she deems unnecessary.

She has larger breasts than Hiroko, her junior in college, which divides her popularity at her school. She is good friends with Hiroko, and they often go out to eat and go shopping together in private.
